text: Is Simpson connected with the Mapleton stables?
why: Holmes asks directly in ¶67 whether anything connects Simpson with the interests of the Mapleton stables.

text: Is Simpson connected with the Mapleton stables? — he was working with or for Mapleton
id: q.simpson_mapleton=he was working with or for Mapleton
why: This is the possibility Holmes's question raises. Simpson had come to get information about Desborough, the Mapleton horse (¶40), so a reader has reason to consider it.
